surface_value: Many residents over the years have gone to these centers for prescriptions to manage their chronic pain. Chanda Lynn and Adrian both wonder why a town of 30,000 needs two adjacent clinics offering pain medicine, which can also be prescribed by doctors at the medical center just up the hill.
